product_name: Bajaj Life Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked Non-Participating Group Term Insurance Plan
key_benefits: One-year renewable government-scheme group term life cover (under the Govt. of India PMJJBY scheme) for savings-bank account holders, with the Bank as Master Policyholder
Death Benefit (Sum Assured) on death of the insured member from any cause after the lien period
Enrolment through a simple proposal form with NO medical underwriting

eligibility.policy_term: One-year cover from 1st June to 31st May, renewable on 1st June each year.
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Annual; premium auto-debited from the member's savings bank account in one instalment (pro-rata if joining mid-year).
eligibility.note: Entry 18-50 years (savings-bank account holders); cover terminates on attaining age 55. Premium stated in the brochure as Rs. 436 plus applicable tax (inclusive of Rs.30 acquisition + Rs.11 administrative cost to participating banks); renewal premium is revisable on annual renewal. Sum Assured per the PMJJBY scheme (commonly Rs. 2,00,000) — capped to Rs. 2,00,000 if duplicated across accounts/insurers.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the policy document, except where the policy tenure is less than a year. Refund of premium less proportionate risk premium and expenses; processed within 7 days.
key_terms.grace_period: 30 days from the Annual Renewal date; cover continues in-force during the grace period and lapses if premium is unpaid at the end of it.
key_terms.waiting_period: Lien/waiting period of 30 days for new members enrolling on or after 1.06.2022: on death due to accident the Sum Assured is paid; on death due to any non-accidental cause during the lien period, NO benefit is payable.
key_terms.suicide_clause: Not separately stated in the brochure; the brochure states there are no exclusions (subject to the 30-day lien period for non-accidental death).
key_terms.maturity_benefit: No maturity benefit under this plan.
key_terms.loan: No loan facility (not applicable to this scheme plan).
key_terms.tax_note: Premium, benefits and Death Benefit 'may be eligible' for tax benefits as per extant Income Tax Act, subject to provisions therein and as amended; consult a tax consultant. GST per prevailing tax laws.

claims_marketing_must_support: This is a one-year renewable PURE-RISK government-scheme group term plan — cover runs 1 June to 31 May and must be renewed annually; there is NO maturity benefit.
A 30-day lien period applies to new members: during it, non-accidental death pays NO benefit and only accidental death is covered — any 'cover from day one' claim must be lien-qualified.
Eligibility is restricted to savings-bank account holders aged 18-50; cover ceases at age 55.
If a member is covered under PMJJBY through more than one account/insurer, cover is restricted to Rs. 2,00,000 and duplicate premiums are forfeited.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position as a savings, investment or money-back product — there is NO maturity or survival benefit; it is pure-risk term cover.
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns' or 'bonus' language — non-linked, non-participating.
Do NOT imply unconditional day-one cover for all causes — non-accidental death is excluded during the 30-day lien period for new members.
Do NOT misstate the premium as fixed forever — the renewal premium is revisable on annual renewal dates.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — carry the 'may be eligible / as per applicable tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-Linked Non-Participating Group Term Insurance Plan' (Govt. of India PMJJBY scheme)
The 30-day lien-period condition for new members (non-accidental death not covered during the lien period)
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document for full terms and exclusions

gaps: Sum Assured amount not printed as a number in the parsed body (the duplicate-cover cap of Rs.2,00,000 implies the scheme SA; verify the exact Sum Assured against the policy document / current PMJJBY scheme rules).
No explicit standalone suicide clause in the brochure (brochure states 'There are no exclusions' subject to the lien period).
